args.text:
MEMO — Q1 2026 US Software Subscriptions (GL 6200): board deck vs. GL
Prepared by: david.murguia@gmail.com (senior accountant) | Date: 2026-04-03 | Analysis only — no entries posted

1. THE DECK NUMBER
DOC-0207, "Q1 2026 board deck – Appendix B: US operating expense detail," reports Software Subscriptions (GL 6200), Q1 2026 = USD 11,769.00. The deck states it was prepared by FP&A from the GL "as of 2026-04-01 09:00."

2. THE GL TODAY
US GL 6200 activity (functional currency USD):
  Jan-2026  4,289.70
  Feb-2026  4,139.80
  Mar-2026  6,139.50
  Q1 total 14,569.00 (cumulative ending balance at 2026-03-31)

3. THE DIFFERENCE — FULLY EXPLAINED, ONE ITEM
  GL today                                    14,569.00
  less Tessellate BI Q1 seat true-up          (2,800.00)
  = Board deck figure                          11,769.00

The entire USD 2,800.00 variance is JE-00304, "Tessellate BI – TB-Q1-TRUEUP – Q1 seat true-up," dated 2026-03-31, Dr 6200 / Cr 2000, supported by DOC-0206 (Tessellate BI invoice TB-Q1-TRUEUP, 2026-03-31, Q1 seat true-up for 14 additional seats, Jan–Mar). The entry was created by ap.clerk at 2026-04-02 10:14 — i.e. roughly 25 hours AFTER the deck's 2026-04-01 09:00 data pull. This is a timing/cut-off difference, not an error in either the deck or the ledger: FP&A's extract was simply taken before the true-up was booked. The reconciliation ties to the cent with no residual.

4. ITEMS RULED OUT
- Duplicate charge test: two identical Zoom charges of USD 149.90 both dated 2026-03-08 (JE-00247 / DOC-0173 and JE-00248 / DOC-0174) initially looked like a double-post. They are NOT duplicates — the bank statement shows two separate settlements the same day (BT-US-0062 and BT-US-0063, each -149.90). Both entries are properly supported and both should stay.
- All 19 Q1 entries in GL 6200 carry support; monthly Tessellate BI and Quire Docs subscriptions are present in each of Jan, Feb and Mar; no missing or misclassified vendor bills were identified.

5. THE CORRECT Q1 FIGURE
The GL's 14,569.00 is correct as far as it goes, but Q1 is not yet complete. The March amortization of the Figtree Platform annual license has not been booked: per DOC-0067 (Prepaid software amortization schedule, GL 1210) the license is USD 15,000.00 over 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31, USD 1,250.00/month, with Jan and Feb booked (JE-00108, JE-00204) and "Mar-2026: to be booked at March close." This is corroborated by GL 1210, which still carries 12,500.00 at 2026-03-31 (15,000 less only two months) with zero March activity, and by the open US checklist item "Amortize prepaid software."

  GL 6200 as posted today                     14,569.00
  plus March Figtree prepaid amortization       1,250.00 (Dr 6200 / Cr 1210, per DOC-0067)
  CORRECT Q1 2026 US SOFTWARE SUBSCRIPTIONS   USD 15,819.00

Versus the deck's 11,769.00, the board figure is understated by USD 4,050.00 (2,800.00 true-up + 1,250.00 March amortization).

6. RECOMMENDATION
Do not restate the ledger — nothing in it is wrong. Have FP&A refresh Appendix B after the March close entries are complete and present USD 15,819.00 as the Q1 figure. The USD 1,250.00 amortization entry is supported by DOC-0067 and should be posted under the existing "Amortize prepaid software" checklist item; per this task's scope I have made no postings and left the checklist item open. No exceptions were raised, as every element of the variance is fully supported by source documents.
